content.user_title: Enhance Images for Clearer Professional Results
content.value_statement: Low-resolution or compressed images can look unclear in documentation, presentations, and social posts. This skill guides targeted upscaling, sharpening, cleanup, and output optimization.
actual_capabilities: Assesses image resolution, sharpness, and visible compression issues before enhancement.
Guides upscaling, edge sharpening, noise reduction, and text clarity improvements.
Supports requests for one image or every PNG in a selected folder.
Adapts enhancement goals for web, print, presentations, and social platforms.
Suggests PNG or JPG output based on quality and file size needs.
limitations: This skill provides workflow instructions and includes no bundled image processing engine or script.
Available enhancement quality depends on the image tools and models in the host environment.
Upscaling cannot recreate all missing detail and may introduce artifacts.
Batch operations require careful folder selection, write access, and enough storage for preserved originals.

use_cases.title: Clarify Documentation Screenshots
use_cases.description: Sharpen interface text and reduce compression artifacts before adding screenshots to technical guides.

use_cases.title: Prepare Social Media Images
use_cases.description: Resize and optimize images for a named social platform while balancing clarity and file size.

use_cases.title: Upscale Presentation Visuals
use_cases.description: Increase image resolution for large displays while preserving aspect ratio and reviewing edge quality.

prompt_templates.title: Improve One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve [image path] for documentation. Preserve the original and save the enhanced result beside it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a basic enhancement with a clear destination.

prompt_templates.title: Repair Screenshot Clarity
prompt_templates.prompt: Sharpen [image path] and reduce compression artifacts. Keep text edges clean and report the output dimensions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a screenshot contains blurry text or visible compression.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize for a Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Upscale [image path] to [dimensions] for [platform]. Preserve aspect ratio, avoid halos, and compare the output size with the source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when exact dimensions and publishing requirements are known.

prompt_templates.title: Process a Folder Consistently
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance every PNG in [folder] for [use case]. Preserve originals, apply consistent settings, and list each created file with its dimensions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced batch workflow with traceable outputs.

output_examples.input: Enhance docs/login.png for a high-resolution documentation page.
output: Created docs/login-enhanced.png at 2560 by 1440 pixels with clearer text edges and fewer compression artifacts.

output_examples.input: Prepare campaign.jpg for a LinkedIn post without changing its aspect ratio.
output: Prepared a platform-sized JPG while preserving the source aspect ratio.
Applied moderate sharpening and compression cleanup.
Reported the final dimensions and file size for review.

output_examples.input: Enhance every PNG in the slides folder for presentation use.
output: Processed each PNG with consistent presentation settings.
Saved enhanced copies with distinct filenames and retained the originals.
Listed every output image with its dimensions and file size.

best_practices: State the intended destination and exact dimensions before enhancement.
Preserve source images and write enhanced results to distinct filenames.
Inspect text edges, halos, noise, and file size before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite source images before reviewing enhanced copies.
Do not apply aggressive sharpening to every image without visual inspection.
Do not request vague improvement when dimensions, format, or destination are important.

faq.question: Does this skill include an image processing engine?
faq.answer: No. It provides enhancement workflow instructions and depends on image tools available in the host environment.

faq.question: Which images work best?
faq.answer: Screenshots and digital images with moderate blur, noise, or compression artifacts are the strongest candidates.

faq.question: Can it enhance an entire folder?
faq.answer: Yes, it describes batch requests for folder images when the host environment supports file access and image processing.

faq.question: Will it preserve original files?
faq.answer: The workflow instructs the agent to preserve originals. Verify output paths before any batch operation.

faq.question: Can it create true detail from a low-resolution source?
faq.answer: No. Upscaling can improve presentation, but it cannot reliably recreate detail missing from the source.

faq.question: Which output format should I request?
faq.answer: Use PNG when clarity is the priority. Use JPG when smaller file size is more important.
